cands.bio: Maurice McCaney is a Republican attorney and partner at Woodruff & McCaney, LLC in Lauderdale County. He previously worked at TVA nuclear plants. He defeated incumbent Phillip Pettus in the May 2026 primary and is the member-elect for Alabama House District 1.

endorsements.text: Endorsed by the Alabama Farmers Federation (listed on Ballotpedia).
Endorsed by Stand for Health Freedom (listed on Ballotpedia).

cands.gaps: He has not held office, so there is no voting record or record of bills he sponsored. We found no statements from him on data centers, homestead property tax elimination, limits on out-of-state or institutional land buyers, growth and land protection, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay, or teacher pay. His site says he opposes raising taxes and wants parents to have more say in education, but it does not mention homestead taxes, vouchers or charters. His site also lists support for private property rights without detail. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. His birthplace and lifelong residence come only from his own campaign site. We found no news coverage or controversies about him. Wikipedia has only a one-line entry.

qual.background: Licensed Alabama attorney since 2014 and partner at Woodruff & McCaney, LLC. Earlier he was a senior project manager at TVA's Bellefonte plant and an assistant unit operator at Browns Ferry, and he served as an IBEW union steward. He has held no elected office.
